upstream.paper: CVPR 2025: A Bias-Free Training Paradigm for More General AI-generated Image Detection

architecture.inference: five 504-pixel crops averaged by the released wrapper

motivation.observed_gap: A single local, metadata-stripped complex AI-image smoke test remained AI-positive after JPEG85 but was indeterminate after a 125-percent display-scale plus WebP80 transform.
motivation.interpretation: This is one regression-style smoke observation, not an accuracy estimate or threshold-selection dataset.

decision.reason: No complete, hash-verified weight file or local inference result exists. The detector has not passed a frozen cross-generator and transformed-real evaluation.
next_gate: verify the complete official weight against the published MD5
run one bounded CPU subprocess to measure peak memory and single-image latency
freeze a calibration protocol without target-generator leakage
require an independently held-out cross-generator and WebP/screenshot-style evaluation before any product contribution

scope: B-Free is a candidate pixel-forensic complement. It is not P0 projective geometry, not provenance evidence, and must not change the origin decision until it clears the recorded gates.
